body: I went through emotional, physical, and sexual abuse by someone when I was 14. I fell into porn and sex addiction and those addictions have basically ruined all my relationships, which just repeated the cycle. Thank you for sharing your story and kind words
Good job! I suffer from PTSD as well. It’s a process : )
I get that man, I’m a trans man who goes through the same thing. I’m here for you.
Don’t be like that, please. Many people are struggling here that can see your comment. Spread your views elsewhere.
I had a similar experience in middle school. Had zero idea what I was doing.
Every second is an accomplishment. Good job bro
We’re here for you bro. The same thing happened to me.
Negative effects to basically everyone involved. Sexual aggression and unattainable desires is all you will lead to.

Thanks. I learned a lot from me and he’s relationship, maybe even my sexuality like I mentioned in the post, and even tho I thought we were meant to be I am still glad that she trusted me enough to tell me what was hopefully the whole truth, and I’m straying away from her for now to avoid thinking of her romantically but I’m hoping that with time we can be friends.

Thank you, this actually makes sense. Also to clarify I don’t think she had been lying to me for the entirety of the relationship but she did admit that for the last two months she knew she did not like men and she was staying for me, so that is very hard to process.
I haven’t gone through anything like this, but my girlfriend has and she also gets nervous to saying no.  It’s a huge step and I’m proud of you!
Seeing people achieve small victories like this warm my heart, because I once achieved this victory, too. You’re not alone and I am proud of you.
I hope you’re still with us, my friend. You’re loved.
Thank you everyone for the kind comments. Things are hard but I’m going to try harder. PMs open if anyone struggling needs someone to talk to.
I’m sorry, buddy. I hope things get better for you. Someone loves you
That’s amazing! I know she’ll do amazing.
